description: The file defines the VoiceWakeRuntime actor responsible for managing the voice wake and speech recognition pipeline, including starting, stopping, handling recognition updates, managing audio input, and coordinating UI overlays. It includes speech recognition setup, audio level monitoring, and event handling for voice triggers in a macOS app.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing active voice wake recognition, including setup, recognition, and overlay coordination.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates and manages recognition pipeline based on app state, starting or stopping recognition as needed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition session with a given configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recognition pipeline, dismisses overlays, cancels tasks, and resets internal states.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Sets up the speech recognizer with the appropriate locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition updates, matching triggers, updating overlays, and managing capture lifecycle.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs transcription debug info if enabled.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs audio RMS levels and updates UI overlay levels.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs recognition callback info.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for trigger-only pause detection.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a silence detection check before starting capture.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if only trigger was detected and begins capture if conditions are met.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines if the current transcript contains only the trigger keywords.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Performs fallback detection based on silence if no trigger detected.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts audio capture and associated overlays, or triggers Talk Mode if enabled.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors capture duration and silences, finalizing when thresholds reached.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends capture, processes final transcript, updates UI, and triggers forwarding.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates noise floor estimate and overlay level based on RMS audio levels.

methods.name: rmsLevel
methods.description: Calculates RMS level from audio buffer.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the speech recognition pipeline.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts recognizer if not capturing and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a recognition restart after a delay.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Sets cooldown to prevent immediate retriggering.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition to enter push-to-talk mode.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks if speech was heard beyond the trigger keyword.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts command text after the trigger keyword.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Gets the command text after trigger end time if available.
